# Primary Identity
Name: Dr. Golan Ben-Dor
Hebrew Name: ד״ר גולן בן-דור
Title: Urban Mobility Scientist
Website: https://drbendor.com

# Professional Summary
Dr. Golan Ben-Dor is an urban mobility simulation scientist specializing in agent-based modeling, MATSim, and transport policy evaluation. He holds a PhD from Tel Aviv University and works as a strategic consultant with Israel's Ministry of Transport, Netivei Israel, Netivei Ayalon, and the Central Bureau of Statistics.

# Expertise Areas
- Urban Mobility Simulation
- Agent-Based Transport Modeling
- MATSim (Multi-Agent Transport Simulation)
- Congestion Pricing Policy
- Traffic Simulation and Analysis
- Smart Cities and Data-Driven Urbanism
- Google Maps Traffic Analytics
- Spatial Analytics and GIS
- Machine Learning for Transport

# Key Publications
1. "Robust Policy Evaluation" - Transportation Research Part A (2024)
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tra.2024.104061
   Topic: Agent-based evaluation of congestion charges in Jerusalem

2. "Agent-Based Modeling at Scale" - Simulation Modelling Practice and Theory (2023)
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.simpat.2023.102775
   Topic: Parallel framework for large-scale MATSim simulations

3. "Population Downscaling in MATSim" - Simulation Modelling Practice and Theory (2021)
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.simpat.2020.102233
   Topic: Comparing full and sampled populations in transport simulation
